# Perkasa Jaya Marine

> Perkasa Jaya Marine adalah Dealer Resmi Yamaha Marine (mesin tempel / outboard Yamaha) di Padang, Sumatera Barat, Indonesia. Kami menjual mesin tempel Yamaha 2 tak dan 4 tak, suku cadang asli Yamaha, dan oli Yamalube, serta melayani semua jenis servis mesin tempel Yamaha di bengkel Toko Tunggal Jaya.
>
> Perkasa Jaya Marine is an authorized Yamaha Marine (outboard) dealer in Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia. It sells Yamaha 2-stroke and 4-stroke outboards, Yamaha genuine parts and Yamalube oils, and does all types of Yamaha Marine servicing at its Toko Tunggal Jaya workshop.

## Toko / Stores

- Perkasa Jaya Marine — Jalan Imam Bonjol No. 27D, Padang, Sumatera Barat. Telepon: +62 751 840010.
- Toko Tunggal Jaya — Jalan M. Yamin SH No 144, Padang, Sumatera Barat. Telepon: +62 751 36628. Lokasi servis dan bengkel (workshop) mesin tempel Yamaha.
- WhatsApp (kedua toko / both stores): +62 878-8282-8232 — https://wa.me/6287882828232
- Jam buka (kedua toko): Senin–Sabtu, 08.00–17.00 WIB; Minggu tutup. / Opening hours (both stores): Monday–Saturday, 08:00–17:00 WIB (UTC+7); closed on Sunday.

## Harga / Prices

- Harga tidak dicantumkan di situs. Hubungi kami untuk harga dan ketersediaan (WhatsApp atau telepon).
- Prices are not published on the site. Contact us for price and availability (WhatsApp or phone).
